```bash

import subprocess, sys

    sys.executable, 'lerobot/scripts/eval.py',
    '--policy.path', 'lerobot/smolvla_libero_plus',
    '--tasks', 'libero_10',
    '--out_dir', '/root/acib/outputs/baseline_plus_v2',
    '--n_episodes', '50',

# 确认进程启动
```
